cause: Controller selected the CPU-only v31 guest DLL closure for the physical NPU worker; it lacks both openvino_ir_frontend.dll and openvino_intel_npu_plugin.dll. The first prewarm failed during IR model reading.
correction: Require and record hashes of OpenVINO core, IR frontend and NPU plugin before configuring the guest. Retry with the complete locked runtime used for component qualification.
